label: training setup
persona: You want to train a custom model on your own art. You know roughly what you want -- your own subject, a trigger word, and you've heard training takes 'steps' -- but you are vague about specifics and get impatient if asked more than one clarifying question in a row. Keep messages short.
opening: i want to train something on my art
goal: See whether the concierge gathers subject/trigger/steps intent, states plainly what it cannot yet see (the user's own datasets), and either proposes the training flow honestly or hands off clearly instead of guessing.
givingUp: The assistant has given you a concrete, honest next step toward training, or it has asked you the same clarifying question twice.
